elite: Fair. That is the right place to start.
Good. Nobody has asked us that yet.
Okay, that is useful framing. Go on.
weak: Walk me through what that means for my team.
Okay. What does the next step look like?
Help me understand how that works in practice.
trap: Hold on. That is a big assumption.
I am not sure you have understood how we work here.

objection_moves.elite: That is a fair concern. Before I answer, is that the main thing holding you back, or is there something else?
objection_moves.weak: We hear that a lot, and honestly it never turns out to be a real problem.
objection_moves.trap: If it helps, I can offer a discount to get past that.

objection_why: Acknowledge it, isolate it, then answer it. A discount or a dismissal tells the buyer the concern was real.
walkout: I think we will leave it there for today. Send me something in writing.

verdicts.proven: verified. The buyer said it in their own words.
verdicts.partial: Good opening. The buyer acknowledged it, so now pin it down.
verdicts.objection: Handled. You isolated the concern before answering it.
verdicts.weak: Too soft. The buyer gave you nothing you can cite.
verdicts.trap: Red flag. That move cost you trust.
